title: Using Clonidine to Improve Leg Weakness in People With Heart Failure
brief_summary: People with heart failure often have weakness in their leg muscles. This study will determine whether the leg weakness is due to very high adrenaline levels and whether the medication clonidine can improve leg weakness.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Heart failure

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently on Coumadin therapy
* Experienced a heart attack in the 3 months before study entry
* Medically unable to receive clonidine
* Advanced kidney or liver disease
